#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string x;
    cin >> n >> x;

    int max_len = 0;
    int countw = 0;
    int i = 0;
    bool inside = false;
    int open = 0;
    int count = 0;

    while (i < n) {
        if (!inside) {
            char c = x[i];
            if (c == '_') {
                i++;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                inside = true;
                open = i;
                count = 0;
                i++;
            } else {
                int wc = 0;
                while (i < n && x[i] != '_' && x[i] != '(') {
                    wc++;
                    i++;
                }
                max_len = max(max_len, wc);
            }
        } else {
            while (i < n && x[i] != ')') {
                if (x[i] == '_') {
                    if (count > 0) {
                        countw++;
                        count = 0;
                    }
                } else if (x[i] != '(') {
                    count++;
                }
                i++;
            }
            if (i < n) {
                if (count > 0) {
                    countw++;
                }
                i++;
            } else {
                i = open + 1;
            }
            inside = false;
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    cout << max_len << " " << countw << endl;
    return 0;
}
